edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender as the effective caller.
msg.sender becomes the transfer source through _msgSender when transfer/transferFrom are called.
withdrawStuckETH forwards the whole ETH balance to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
withdrawStuckETH performs a low-level value call to msg.sender.
withdrawStuckETH is gated by the tradingOpen state variable.
block.timestamp drives cooldown expiry and market-hour checks in _transfer.
marketOpened parses block.timestamp to decide whether trading is allowed.
_transfer invokes marketOpened with block.timestamp as a gating condition.
swapTokensForEth uses block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
addLiquidity uses block.timestamp as the router liquidity deadline.
swapBack sends ETH to external wallets via low-level calls before finishing accounting.
Remaining ETH is sent to the _projectWallet address in a payable call.
Accrued development ETH is sent to _developmentWallet in a payable call.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert contract tokens to ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity to add token/ETH liquidity.
addLiquidity makes an external call into the Uniswap router.
swapTokensForEth makes an external call into the Uniswap router.
_transfer triggers swapBack when swap conditions are satisfied.
The swapping flag is read and written around swapBack to guard reentrancy.
_transfer delegates balance movement to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _takeFees which performs fee arithmetic.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard for the final balance update.
Fee multiplication and division inside _takeFees constitute the arithmetic operation.
Balance sub/add in _transferStandard constitute the arithmetic operation.
_takeFees increments tokensForProject using fee math.
_takeFees increments tokensForDev using fee math.
_takeFees increments tokensForLiquidity using fee math.
transfer forwards the call to _transfer.
transferFrom forwards the call to _transfer.
approve delegates to _approve.
transferFrom delegates allowance reduction to _approve.
openTrading assigns the created Uniswap pair to uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading assigns the Uniswap router to uniswapV2Router.
manualswap requires msg.sender to equal _projectWallet.
manualsend requires msg.sender to equal _projectWallet.
manualswap performs an unrestricted token swap via swapTokensForEth.
manualsend drains contract ETH to fee wallets via sendETHToFee.
sendETHToFee transfers half the amount to _projectWallet.
sendETHToFee transfers half the amount to _developmentWallet.
setProjectWallet rewrites the _projectWallet state variable.
setDevelopmentWallet rewrites the _developmentWallet state variable.
setLiquidityWallet rewrites the _liquidityWallet state variable.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
_isExcludedFromFee determines whether fees and restrictions apply in _transfer.
bots blacklist is checked to block flagged addresses in _transfer.
cooldown mapping is read and written against block.timestamp in _transfer.
swapTokensAtAmount gates the automatic swap in _transfer.
tradingActiveBlock selects the punitive fee branch in _takeFees.
blocksToBlacklist defines the punitive fee window in _takeFees.
_marketingFee participates in fee math in _takeFees.
_liquidityFee participates in fee math in _takeFees.
_takeFees calls _getTotalFees to obtain the aggregate fee.
from parameter feeds the _transfer logic.
to parameter feeds the _transfer logic.
amount parameter feeds the _transfer logic.
takeFee local variable controls fee application in _transfer.
shouldSwap local variable controls swap triggering in _transfer.
sender parameter is used to update balances in _transferStandard.
recipient parameter is used to update balances in _transferStandard.
tAmount parameter is used to update balances in _transferStandard.
amount parameter is used in the fee computation of _takeFees.
fees local variable holds the computed fee in _takeFees.
projectWallet parameter is assigned to the _projectWallet state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to serve _transfer and should be folded into that core function node.
The to parameter only exists to serve _transfer and should be folded into that core function node.
The amount parameter only exists to serve _transfer and should be folded into that core function node.
The takeFee local flag is purely internal to _transfer and should merge into it.
The shouldSwap local flag is purely internal to _transfer and should merge into it.
The sender parameter is a direct input of _transferStandard and should merge into it.
The recipient parameter is a direct input of _transferStandard and should merge into it.
The tAmount parameter is a direct input of _transferStandard and should merge into it.
The amount parameter is a direct input of _takeFees and should merge into it.
The fees local variable is produced solely inside _takeFees and should merge into it.
The projectWallet parameter is a direct input of setProjectWallet and should merge into it.
